watches.name: Midland Meteorite Automatic
watches.description: The DELMA Midland Meteorite pairs distinctive Swiss watchmaking with the extraordinary character of a g enuine Muonio nalusta Meteorite. Formed billions of years ago, this rare natural material reveals an int ricate Widman stätten pattern, giving each dial its own unique crystalline texture and character. The stainless-steel case retains the Midland collection’s signature tonneau-shaped design, fluted bezel and integrated stainless-steel bracelet, enhanced by contrasting brushed and polished surfaces. A sapphire crystal, 10 ATM water resistance and Super- LumiNova ® BGW9 hand s and indexes provide durability and clear legibility. Inside, the watch is powered by a Swiss Made Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement, featuring a DELMA-customized rotor visible through the exhibition case back. Limited to 100 pieces worldwide, the DELMA Midland is a distinctive expression of Swiss precision, contemporary design and a material with a remarkable natural history.

watches.name: Cayman Bronze
watches.description: The Cayman collection pays homage to the sea with inspiration from DELMA’s skin divers’ watches of the 1970s. The bronze edition is crafted from antimagnetic and corrosion resistant CUSN6 superior grade bronze, admired for the unique patina formed as it is exposed to the elements. The structured red gradient dial contributes to the natural finish while large luminescent numerals, indexes and hands in Super-LumiNova C3 provide essential legibility in all conditions. With a unidirectional rotating bezel and water resistance to 500 m /1650 ft, the Cayman effortlessly lends itself to deep sea excursions as well as seaside leisure. The brown hybrid Cordura rubber strap conforms to the wrist for ultimate comfort and is equipped with quick release spring bars for easy strap changes. The DELMA customized movement with gold rotor is revealed through the stainless-steel case back with a central display window.

watches.name: Commander 40mm
watches.description: The DELMA Commander 40 mm combines the functional clarity of a classic pilot’s watch with a refined modern profile. Crafted in stainless steel, it features a matte salmon-colored dial paired with a hand-made brown Italian leather strap, creating a distinctive balance of utility and understated elegance. Designed for everyday reliability, the newly developed 40 mm case offers enhanced comfort and wearability while preserving the bold legibility central to the Commander collection. Fully luminous Arabic numerals, a precise minute track, 24-hour scale, and discreet date display ensure optimal readability in all conditions. Powered by the reliable Swiss automatic SW200-1 movement, visible through the case back, the Commander continues DELMA’s tradition of purposeful watchmaking with a contemporary field-inspired character.

watches.name: Shell Star 41mm Automatic
watches.description: The Shell Star 41mm brings a new dimension to the brand’s most recognizable dive watches. It maintains the bold presence and reliability the Shell Star collection is known for in a more compact and versatile size. Inspired by DELMA’s iconic divers’ watches of the 1970s, the refined proportions and signature elements carry forward the spirit of the original. The stainless-steel unidirectional bezel is accentuated with a luminous marker at 12 o’clock for precise dive timing. The black dial is complemented by bold hands and applied hour markers with Super-LumiNova BGW9, ensuring exceptional legibility in all lighting conditions. Powered by the reliable automatic SW200-1 movement and with water resistance to 200 meters, it delivers performance for everyday enjoyment and underwater exploration. The stainless steel three-link bracelet completes the combination of style and comfort. With its reduced dimensions and refined profile, the Shell Star 41mm represents the next evolution of a true dive classic, smaller, slimmer, and ready to accompany your next adventure.

watches.name: Oceanmaster Lume
watches.description: Designed for explorers who demand unwavering visibility and reliability in any condition, DELMA’s Oceanmaster collection has set the standard for precision, durability, and nautical innovation. The Lume edition carries this legacy forward, featuring fully luminous dials that shine with clarity and confidence, day and night. In daylight, the vibrant blue dial is a striking stage for the signature points-of-sail indicator. After sunset, the fully glowing dial showcases vibrant green hands and indexes to highlight critical navigational elements, ensuring clarity when it matters most. The stainless-steel nautical bezel and integrated tactical planner ensure precision when plotting a course while the framed date display at 6 o’clock provides legibility at a glance. Encased in solid stainless steel and water-resistant to 500 meters, the Oceanmaster Lume is built to withstand the harshest conditions with unwavering strength and reliability.

Its versatile size and thoughtfully crafted details make it a standout choice for those who value everyday luxury with enduring style.

watches.name: Shell Star Big Date
watches.description: The Shell Star collection traces its origins back to 1975, when DELMA introduced its first professional dive watch under this iconic name. This pioneering timepiece set a benchmark for the brand, inspiring a legacy of robust and reliable divers’ watches. The latest Shell Star Big Date stays true to its heritage while integrating modern advancements. Built for the toughest conditions, its brushed stainless steel case features a screw-down crown for enhanced durability, a helium escape valve, and an impressive water resistance of 500 m / 1650 ft. The bold, applied luminous orange indexes and a black unidirectional bezel ensure optimal readability in any environment. A striking blue gradient dial is complemented by an orange-framed big date display at 12 o’clock, balancing functionality with a distinctive aesthetic. Designed for both everyday wear and professional diving, the Shell Star Big Date comes fitted with a resilient stainless steel bracelet. Meanwhile, the automatic movement, visible through the transparent case back, underscores its precision and craftsmanship making it a true companion for underwater adventures and beyond.

The second edition is a refined evolution of the original sable black version, featuring a signature DELMA salmon grains de riz guilloché pattern dial. The timepiece is fitted with a stainless-steel bracelet with a deployant clasp and quick-release spring bars allow the wearer to easily switch to the additional brown Italian leather strap without the need for tools. This exclusive timepiece is supplied in a sumptuous presentation box and is limited to only 25 pieces. Deliveries and availability at select DELMA retailers begin end of May.

watches.name: Heritage Chronograph 100 Years LE
watches.description: The Heritage Chronograph 100 Years LE is special adaption of its early predecessors that was created in celebration of DELMA's 100th anniversary. Original features such as the Tachymeter, Telemeter and Arabic numerals are enlarged and invigorated with red accents to enhance style and distinctiveness. The date is accompanied by a day tracker for ultimate convenience and punctuality. The smooth Italian leather strap, accentuated with coordinating red stitching, further enhances this dynamic classic. With water resistance up to 100 meters and a scratch-resistant domed sapphire crystal, the new Heritage Chronograph is a stylish and practical companion for any occasion. Limited to 100 pieces, it exudes a century of Swiss Made craftmanship.

watches.name: Midland Automatic 40mm
watches.description: The Midland is based on a model bearing the same name from the 1980’s with a twist. The overall composition recalls the decade’s bold geometric forms with a new integrated bracelet that blends seamlessly with the tonneau shaped case. The addition of the fluted bezel adds a classic edge and contrast to the smooth brushed elements. The ice blue dial is enhanced with a pyramid guilloche pattern. Appointed with applied baton indexes and hour and minute hands with Super-LumiNova BGW9, timing is always legible at a glance. With water resistance to 10 atm, the stainless-steel case is sealed with an exhibition case back revealing the automatic movement and DELMA customized rotor. Complete with a folding clasp with pushers, the latest DELMA Midland continues the collection’s pledge to functionality and style that is enjoyable to wear and made to prevail.

watches.name: 1924 Tourbillon
watches.description: The DELMA 1924 Tourbillon signifies longevity, craftsmanship and progress in honor of our 100th anniversary. The tourbillon sits at the heart of DELMA’s proprietary 100% Swiss Caliber DT100.01, a hand-wound movement with a prodigious power reserve of 105 hours. The dial is executed in sable black and features a grained finish. The hour and minute hands are palladium, nickel-plated, and lined with white Super-LumiNova® BGW9. The 41mm stainless-steel case radiates quality and pays tribute to the brand’s design aesthetic. Fitted with a stainless-steel bracelet with a deployant clasp, quick-release spring bars allow the wearer to switch to the additional black Italian leather strap without requiring the use of tools. This exclusive timepiece is supplied in a sumptuous presentation box and limited to 100 pieces in celebration of 100 years of DELMA. Each 1924 Tourbillon is made to order; please allow 2-3 weeks for production and shipping.

Engineered in solid stainless steel with a black DLC unidirectional bezel, the Blue Shark IV combines robust construction with refined craftsmanship. An interchangeable stainless-steel bracelet and genuine rubber strap provide versatility for every adventure, making this professional diver a powerful companion on land and at sea.

watches.name: Shell Star Titanium
watches.description: The Shell Star Titanium is sleeker and lighter than ever. Weighing in at only 136 grams, this exciting evolution of DELMA’s signature Shell Star collection is lightweight and robust. With compact proportions for a divers’ watch at 41mm in diameter and just 13.6mm thick, it is exceptionally comfortable and enjoyable to wear in and out of the water. Further special features include two types of luminous, bright blue glowing Super-LumiNova BGW9 to accentuate the bezel, and neon green glowing Super-LumiNova C3 for the applied indexes and bold hands. The sand textured blue dial is complimented by a scratch resistant ceramic bezel, the collection’s signature railway track, and date window. Despite the smaller proportions, the Shell Star Titanium upholds the power of the Shell Star inside and out with water-resistance to 500 m / 1650 ft, the automatic movement is visible through the transparent case back. Limited edition to 499 pieces.

watches.name: Continental Pulsometer
watches.description: The Continental Pulsometer reimagines 1960s style with features to rival any smartwatch. It instinctively accelerates the collection with refined chronographs that evoke automotive advancement and enjoyment of the period. The pulsometer, tachymeter and telemeter functions enable measurement of heart rate, distance and speed without the need for battery power. The discreetly adept design displays essential information at all speeds, under all conditions. The elegant silver sunray brushed dial is complimented by its guilloche bi-compax counters. The applied indexes and hour markers, date window at 6 o'clock, and red central seconds hand refine the timeless look. The quintessential crown and pushers and brushed and polished 7-link bracelet resonate with the nostalgic style to complete the lightweight, comfortable and effortlessly luxurious design. The automatic movement with DELMA engraved côtes de Genève striped finish rotor can be observed through the transparent case back.

watches.name: Quattro
watches.description: The DELMA Quattro is the ultimate decompression divers’ watch making it an essential tool and object of admiration for all levels of divers and watch collectors. Designed and developed with a strong focus on legibility and functionality, its appearance is defined by a unique symmetrical stainless-steel case which subtly integrates the helium escape valve and protects the hidden screw down crown from potential impact. The robust bezel is empowered with six bold notches for easy grip while enhancing the Quattro’s distinctive symmetry. DELMA’s specialized Rapid Bracelet Exchange System (RBES) enables the case to perform in 3 distinct forms. The bracelet and rubber strap can be quickly interchanged without the need for any tools. Likewise, the watch can be effortlessly fixed onto a custom designed decompression plate in a matter of seconds. The new Quattro along with its bespoke accessories epitomizes DELMA’s advancement and ingenuity while taking inspiration from the past. The original DELMA Quattro was launched in the early 80’s with a quartz movement and gained popularity with divers particularly in the US. Over 40 years later, the exclusive 999-piece limited edition series is powered by an automatic SW200-1 movement visible through the transparent case back and is water resistant to 500 m / 1650 ft. The black dial and black DLC bezel ring are attractive and easy to read in all 3 interchangeable formats.

watches.name: Montego
watches.description: The streamlined Montego chronograph prepares the wearer for adventures near and far. Its fixed stainless-steel bezel with prominent tachymeter function enables measurement of speed and distance traveled at a glance. The 42 mm case is a mere 16.2 mm thick but spares no details in functionality or design. The motor sport inspiration is evident from the green sunray brushed dial and guilloche pattern sub dials, ready to perform on circuits or rallies in all terrain. Bold hour, minute hands and a red seconds hand are accompanied by a day-date window crowned with the DELMA logo. Viewing in the dark reveals the Montego has a laudable hidden feature. The hands glow in blue while the indices are illuminated in green yielding distinctive legibility and a unique flair. Complete with a screw down crown and fastened with a green Cordura rubber strap it emanates functionality and strength with limitless aspiration and enthusiasm for precision.

watches.name: Cayman Bronze
watches.description: The Cayman collection pays homage to the sea with inspiration from DELMA’s skin divers’ watches of the 1970s. The bronze edition is crafted from antimagnetic and corrosion resistant CUSN6 superior grade bronze, admired for the unique patina formed as it is exposed to the elements. The green sand textured dial contributes to the natural finish while large luminescent numerals, indexes and hands in Super-LumiNova C3 provide essential legibility in all conditions. With a unidirectional rotating bezel and water resistance to 500 m / 1650 ft, the Cayman effortlessly lends itself to deep sea excursions as well as seaside leisure. The green hybrid Cordura rubber strap conforms to the wrist for ultimate comfort and is equipped with quick release spring bars for easy strap changes. The DELMA customized movement with gold rotor is revealed through the stainless-steel case back with a central display window. Limited edition of 999 pieces.

watches.name: Shell Star Decompression Timer
watches.description: With sophisticated diving technology built upon the design of DELMA’s cherished Shell Star collection, the Shell Star Decompression Timer presents a rarely seen feature in a timepiece that is equally technical, durable and stylish. Key historical characteristics include a spade central seconds hand, the railway track and orange and white indexes. The added functionality of the decompression timer is based on pioneering Swiss research of the 1950s and 60s and clearly displays when decompression stops are needed. Optimized for diving at 0-700 meters above sea level, the coordinating blue unidirectional bezel can be used to precisely time dive duration. The vertical scale on the dial at 12 o‘clock corresponds to the dive depth while the white markings on the rings clearly indicate whether decompression stops are necessary. The solid construction and helium escape valve enable a water resistance to 500 m / 1650 ft and a solid stainless steel bracelet completes a unique diving tool worthy of attention. The automatic movement is visible through the transparent case back.

Key historical characteristics include a spade central seconds hand, the railway track and orange and white indexes. The added functionality of the decompression timer is based on pioneering Swiss research of the 1950s and 60s and clearly displays when decompression stops are needed. Optimized for diving at 0-700 meters above sea level, the coordinating orange unidirectional bezel can be used to precisely time dive duration. The vertical scale on the dial at 12 o‘clock corresponds to the dive depth while the white markings on the rings clearly indicate whether decompression stops are necessary. The solid construction and helium escape valve enable a water resistance to 500 m / 1650 ft and a solid stainless steel bracelet completes a unique diving tool worthy of attention. The automatic movement is visible through the transparent case back.

watches.name: Heritage Chronograph
watches.description: In 1946 DELMA’s first chronograph equipped with a mechanical hand-winding movement represented the beginning of the brand’s expertise in sports watches. 75 years later, the Heritage Chronograph celebrates the development in popularity and everlasting style of this classic timepiece with tribute to its original design and pioneering functionality. The stainless steel Heritage Chronograph maintains the same essential features of the original design with modern functionality and scale. The reduction of the perimeter to include just the tachymeter scale gives the three sub-dial chronograph a modern, sleek appearance while maintaining the essential original characteristics. Sword shaped hour and minute hands with C3 Super-LumiNova stand out against the blue sunray brushed dial. The small seconds hand, 30-minute and 12-hour counters are accentuated with a guilloche pattern. In keeping with the first Heritage model, Arabic numerals are replaced with linear indexes to give a uniform streamlined appeal. The decorated automatic movement with customized DELMA rotor is visible through a transparent case back. The black genuine Italian leather prepares the classic timepiece for universal enjoyment.

This bespoke component enables tracking of the ebb and flow of the sea at port or in the most extreme and remote locations. Set according to the user’s location, high and low tide are clearly indicated on the sleek bezel so aquatic adventurers will always be aware of relevant tidal conditions. In keeping with the collection, the Oceanmaster Tide Chronograph is also equipped with a tactical planner and points of sail indicators making it a consummate tool for sea explorers. The sleek black dial and chronograph counters add the ability to conveniently track the hour, minute and seconds while enhancing the nautical appearance. The robust stainless-steel case is enhanced with crown protection and fastened on by a genuine rubber strap . The quartz movement is sealed with a solid steel case back which is engraved with a unique IMOCA inspired sailboat illustration. The Oceanmaster series represents DELMA’s dedication to creating timepieces that are inspired by experts and designed to exceed the demands of our users.

watches.name: Shell Star
watches.description: The tradition of the Shell Star goes back to 1975, when DELMA’s first professional divers’ watch was launched under this name. This exemplary timepiece became a landmark for the company, serving as a model for a profound series of divers’ watches. The Shell Star of today is undoubtedly tough. The brushed stainless-steel case boasts a screw down crown for enhanced protection and water-resistance to 200 m / 660 ft. The applied luminous orange indexes and orange characteristic unidirectional bezel enable precision in all conditions. The smooth black dial is accented by an orange framed contrasting white date window making it an adaptable classic divers’ watch fit for daily wear but outfitted for professional divers. The quartz movement is sealed within a DELMA engraved case back and the watch is outfitted with a coordinating genuine rubber strap.
